Jurassic World: New Adventures.name: Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous
Jurassic World: New Adventures.desc: Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous follows a group of six teenagers chosen for a once-in-a-lifetime experience at a new adventure camp on the opposite side of Isla Nublar. But when dinosaurs wreak havoc across the island, the campers are stranded. Unable to reach the outside world, they'll need to go from strangers to friends to family if they're going to survive.

Trolljäger: Geschichten aus Arcadia – Ne.name: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia
Trolljäger: Geschichten aus Arcadia – Ne.desc: After uncovering a mysterious amulet, an average teen assumes an unlikely destiny and sets out to save two worlds. Created by Guillermo del Toro.

Wizards - Tales from Arcadia.name: Wizards: Tales of Arcadia
Wizards - Tales from Arcadia.desc: Merlin's apprentice joins Arcadia's heroes on a time-bending adventure in Camelot, where conflict is brewing between the human, troll and magical worlds.

3 Below: Tales from Arcadia.name: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia
3 Below: Tales from Arcadia.desc: After crash-landing on Earth, two royal teen aliens on the run struggle to blend in with humans as they evade intergalactic bounty hunters.

Omnipresent.name: Omniscient
Omnipresent.desc: In a future where each citizen is monitored 24/7 by a drone, a woman discovers a murder unaccounted by this surveillance system, and investigates why.

Explained: Our Brain/Mind.name: The Mind, Explained
Explained: Our Brain/Mind.desc: Our minds are capable of great things, but they can also undermine our best intentions. Delve into the science behind creativity, brainwashing and more.

Avatar: The Legend of Korra.name: The Legend of Korra
Avatar: The Legend of Korra.desc: Avatar Korra fights to keep Republic City safe from the evil forces of both the physical and spiritual worlds.

Avatar: The Legend of Aang.name: Avatar: The Last Airbender
Avatar: The Legend of Aang.desc: A young boy known as the Avatar must master the four elemental powers to save a world at war — and fight a ruthless enemy bent on stopping him.
